posts.title: I'm a Full-Time Open Source Developer Now
posts.description: People get surprised when I mention that I currently maintain not one, not two, but 18 open source projects. For most of my career I handled this work on the side of a day job, but with my day job now gone I am dedicating more time to open source. This is my attempt to advertise what I'm doing a bit better, in case some of you would like to support this work.

posts.title: How fast is Python 3.15?

posts.title: You Should be Using Rootless Containers
posts.description: The other day a serious vulnerability was disclosed in one of the newer Linux distributions (the one led by the racist, so it isn't getting a mention here). The issue was interesting because it was caused by a non-standard Docker configuration that their installer applied by default, without alerting users that this configuration was creating a security risk.
